x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change bodies-term-of-office-and-step-down (bod-07). A membership may carry an end date in the future: the term it was entered for. A body may set how many days ahead its secretary hears that a term ends (termReminderDays, default 90). Membership and PositionHold each declare a scheduled reminder to the secretariat for a term that ends within 90 days. The step-down schedule itself is computed in the browser from memberships and position holds and is never stored (REQ-CTM-008).

termReminderDays.title: Term reminder (days)
termReminderDays.description: How many days before a member's term ends the secretary is reminded.
termReminderDays.x-notes: REQ-TOS-004. Empty means the default of 90 days. The declared reminders below use the default window: the scheduled-notification filter takes a fixed ISO-8601 duration and cannot read a value from another object, so a body-specific window needs the notification engine to support a referenced duration.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: When the term ends or the membership ended. Empty while the term has no end.
endDate.x-notes: REQ-TOS-001 / REQ-TOS-005. May lie in the future: the end of the term the member was entered for. A membership whose end date has passed is a former membership; nothing is written when the date passes.

subject.nl: Termijn van een lid eindigt op {{endDate}}

membershipTermEndsSoon._note: REQ-TOS-004. Daily sweep; a membership whose end date falls within the next 90 days notifies the secretariat once, the engine's fingerprint keeping it from repeating until the membership changes.

subject.nl: Termijn in een functie eindigt op {{endDate}}
subject.en: A term in a position ends on {{endDate}}

positionTermEndsSoon._note: REQ-TOS-004. Daily sweep; a position hold whose end date falls within the next 90 days notifies the secretariat once.
